name: Homebound Plush
description:
Embark on a charming adventure with a teddy bear who was accidentally forgotten by a young boy during a move and must now set out on a journey to reunite with his owner. Run, jump, and explore vibrant pixel art levels, facing enemies and traveling through a variety of environments, including houses, gardens, and city streets.

Collect special items along the way to aid your adventure.

Each level features its own exciting boss battle.

With precise controls, moderate challenges, and a cozy atmosphere, this is the perfect adventure for fans of classic 16-bit platformers. Test your skills through a fun and heartwarming journey filled with charm for players of all ages.
